title: NTRglobal
description: Built and led the UX function at a B2B SaaS company, shifting the product to user-centred design. Drove a 212% increase in conversions and 50% reduction in time on task, while simplifying the product portfolio by half.

metrics.label: decrease in time on task (top 5 tasks)

sections.title: Context
sections.body: NTRglobal was a SaaS company providing network management and remote access products. The company served both enterprise and SMB customers. I established and managed the UX team — designers, copywriters, engineers, and user researchers — and worked directly with the CEO and engineering leadership to shift the product process towards user-centred design.

sections.title: Problem
sections.body: The product portfolio had grown complex and difficult to use. Conversion on sign-up and landing pages was poor. Users were taking too long to complete core tasks, generating high support load. The business problem was competitiveness: the product needed to be simpler and faster to adopt to compete in an increasingly crowded SaaS market.

sections.title: My role
sections.body: I built the product function from scratch and owned the shift from feature-driven to user-centred product development — a change I drove directly with the CEO. I hired and managed the team (designers, researchers, copywriters, engineers), set the product process, and made the call to rationalise the product portfolio based on usage data rather than internal preferences. The SMB product line was my initiative from identification to launch.

sections.title: Approach
sections.body: I introduced a user-centred product process: regular usability testing, task analysis, and research feeding directly into roadmap decisions. The first priority was simplification — the product portfolio was rationalised based on actual usage patterns and user needs rather than internal feature preferences. I redesigned sign-up and landing pages using conversion data and user testing. For SMBs, I identified an underserved segment and led the product definition and design of a dedicated product line.

sections.title: Outcome
sections.body:
• 212% increase in conversions on sign-up and landing pages
  • 50% decrease in time on task for the top 5 user tasks
  • 50%+ simplification of the product portfolio
  • New SMB product line launched
